verdict.rationale: Better Auth is an authentication library/framework, not an automation-building or workflow-orchestration product; there is no concept of 'automations' to version, review, or roll back. The one loosely related item (auth config living in version-controlled code, reviewable in PRs) refers to developer-authored config files, not an AI-native automation feature with rollback semantics, so this axis is a category mismatch for this product.
